extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, petitioners for reinstatement before the USPTO, and USPTO enrollment/discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation and decision on a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office under 37 CFR § 11.58. The Office of Enrollment and Discipline reviews the petition and the record and the Director determines whether reinstatement is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: "Mr. Beers appears to have complied with all provisions of 37 CFR § 11.58."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compliance with the provisions of 37 CFR § 11.58 is treated as a required condition for consideration of reinstatement; the petition should demonstrate compliance with each applicable provision of that regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's review of the petition and record material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: "After careful review of the Petition and all information in the record material to Mr. Beers' eligibility for reinstatement, the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director (Office of Enrollment and Discipline) conducts a careful review of the petition and all record information material to eligibility and exercises discretion to determine whether reinstatement is appropriate; petitions should therefore include and address any record information relevant to eligibility.
